name: eat-decider
description: 校园美食决策助手：共享菜单、三种推荐模式与管理员维护。

scripts.build:pages: npm test && npm run build && node scripts/package-pages.mjs && node scripts/check-build.mjs && npm run test:pages
scripts.preview:pages: node scripts/package-pages.mjs && wrangler pages dev dist/pages --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788 --d1 DB=00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.dev.jsonc
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --config wrangler.dev.jsonc --file scripts/seed.sql
